content:
alex_marketing: Heads-up: benchmark + playbook blog scheduled for TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Need final items by EOD: (1) 1-line CEO soundbite, (2) 2 social drafts (short + thread), (3) 3 press FAQ bullets. Legal, product, ops please sign off. @press_ops_bot run embargo checklist?

press_ops_bot: Embargo checklist started. Proposed embargo: 2026-04-07 16:00Z. Assets locked for marketing+press. Do not share outside this thread. :white_check_mark:

jess_editor: Initial CEO line: "Redwood helps teams ship LLM features with predictable cost and low latency."

mira_ceo: Slight tweak: "Redwood helps teams ship LLM features with predictable costs and low latency so they can ship confidently."

jess_editor: Updated: "Redwood helps teams ship LLM features with predictable costs and low latency so they can ship confidently."

sam_seo: Short social: "New from Redwood: benchmark + playbook for LLM serving at scale. Practical tips to lower unit cost and keep latency low. Read: <link>"

sam_seo: Thread draft (3 tweets):
```
1/ We published a benchmark + playbook for serving LLMs in production.
2/ Highlights: batching, prefix caching, and quantization that reduce unit cost (see methodology).
3/ Includes rollout checklist and ops mitigations to avoid regressions. <link>
```

lisa_legal: Redlines: add "up to" to any savings claim and reference the methodology link. Add embargo notice to assets. Remove any implication of SLA changes.

devin_prod: Press FAQ bullets draft:
- What did you test? -> "Conversational and RAG workloads on representative web-text; see methodology."
- How big are savings? -> "Up to 3x unit-cost reductions in cache-friendly workloads; results vary by model and traffic pattern."
- Will Redwood change pricing? -> "No immediate pricing changes; guidance is operational best practices."

partners_ops: Partner snippet for syndication: "Redwood's benchmark and playbook show practical ops guidance for deploying LLMs at scale. Learn more: <partnerlink>"

ops_oncall: Ops publish plan: enable surge autoscale 30m pre-release, pre-stage lite-model fallback, monitor token spend and error budget in #release-war-room. If token spend breaches threshold, shift public traffic to fallback.

alex_marketing: Action items: legal sign-off by 17:30 PT, partner links with UTM by 18:00 PT, ops to stage autoscale+fallback. If no objections by 18:30 PT we lock assets and press_ops_bot schedules embargo release.

press_ops_bot: Embargo scheduled for 2026-04-07 16:00Z pending final signoffs. I will ping at T-1h. :alarm_clock:
